title: The avoiding late diagnosis of ovarian cancer (ALDO) project; a pilot national surveillance programme for women with pathogenic germline variants in BRCA1 and BRCA2.
authors: Philpott, Sue; Raikou, Maria; Manchanda, Ranjit; Lockley, Michelle; Singh, Naveena; Scott, Malcolm; Evans, D Gareth; Adlard, Julian; Ahmed, Munaza; Edmondson, Richard; Woodward, Emma Roisin; Lamnisos, Athena; Balega, Janos; Brady, Angela F; Sharma, Aarti; Izatt, Louise; Kulkarni, Anjana; Tripathi, Vishakha; Solomons, Joyce S; Hayes, Kevin; Hanson, Helen; Snape, Katie; Side, Lucy; Skates, Steve; McGuire, Alistair; Rosenthal, Adam N
one_liner_zh: 该研究为BRCA1/2突变女性卵巢癌监测的临床项目，纯流行病学与成本效益分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Our study aimed to establish 'real-world' performance and cost-effectiveness of ovarian cancer (OC) surveillance in women with pathogenic germline BRCA1/2 variants who defer risk-reducing bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (RRSO). METHODS: Our study recruited 875 female BRCA1/2-heterozygotes at 13 UK centres and via an online media campaign, with 767 undergoing at least one 4-monthly surveillance test with the Risk of Ovarian Cancer Algorithm (ROCA) test. Surveillance performance was calculated with modelling of occult cancers detected at RRSO. The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) was calculated using Markov population cohort simulation. RESULTS: Our study identified 8 OCs during 1277 women screen years: 2 occult OCs at RRSO (both stage 1a), and 6 screen-detected; 3 of 6 (50%) were </=stage 3a and 5 of 6 (83%) were completely surgically cytoreduced. Modelled sensitivity, specificity, Positive Predictive Value (PPV) and Negative Predictive Value (NPV) for OC were 87.5% (95% CI, 47.3 to 99.7), 99.9% (99.9-100), 75% (34.9-96.8) and 99.9% (99.9-100), respectively. The predicted number of quality-adjusted life years (QALY) gained by surveillance was 0.179 with an ICER cost-saving of - pound102,496/QALY. CONCLUSION: OC surveillance for women deferring RRSO in a 'real-world' setting is feasible and demonstrates similar performance to research trials; it down-stages OC, leading to a high complete cytoreduction rate and is cost-saving in the UK National Health Service (NHS) setting. While RRSO remains recommended management, ROCA-based surveillance may be considered for female BRCA-heterozygotes who are deferring such surgery.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在评估携带致病性胚系BRCA1/2变异且推迟降低风险双侧输卵管卵巢切除术（RRSO）的女性中卵巢癌（OC）监测的“真实世界”表现及成本效益。方法：本研究从英国13个中心及通过在线媒体活动招募了875名BRCA1/2杂合子女性，其中767人接受了至少一次每4个月一次的卵巢癌风险算法（ROCA）测试监测。监测表现通过RRSO时检测到的隐匿性癌症建模计算。增量成本效益比（ICER）采用马尔可夫人群队列模拟计算。结果：本研究在1277个女性筛查年中识别出8例OC：2例为RRSO时发现的隐匿性OC（均为1a期），6例为筛查检出；6例中3例（50%）为≤3a期，6例中5例（83%）实现完全手术肿瘤细胞减灭。建模的OC敏感性、特异性、阳性预测值（PPV）和阴性预测值（NPV）分别为87.5%（95% CI，47.3至99.7）、99.9%（99.9-100）、75%（34.9-96.8）和99.9%（99.9-100）。监测预测获得的质量调整生命年（QALY）为0.179，ICER节省成本为-英镑102,496/QALY。结论：在“真实世界”环境中，对推迟RRSO的女性进行OC监测是可行的，并表现出与研究试验相似的表现；它能降低OC分期，导致高完全细胞减灭率，并在英国国家卫生服务（NHS）环境中节省成本。虽然RRSO仍是推荐的管理方式，但对于推迟此类手术的BRCA杂合子女性，可考虑基于ROCA的监测。
